cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

mechanism: A organizes raffle accounting but transfers custody, counting and explanation of a broken cashbox to B, offering practical help to keep the transfer workable.
confusable: Unlike merely hiding a secret, A reveals the broken lock and makes B handle its evidence and follow-up; authority accommodates storage and supplies the snapped key.
comparison: Physical custody and a face-to-face count differ from tracing a missing receipt through email.
seedUse: D125-a cashbox, unlocked office and broken key; S02-a adjusts arrangements around partner constraints.
